name: Compact
description: Compact proportions, close to the current wordmark.
risk: The 1 is subtle at sidebar size.

name: Wide
description: Wider letters with a larger opening inside each shape.

name: Condensed
description: Narrow letters let the name be taller in the same sidebar.
risk: The narrow A and R need a small-size check.

name: Geometric
description: Rounder O and a broad, straight-sided M.
risk: Less room for the symbol at the same total height.

name: Square
description: Squared curves and lighter strokes, like instrument lettering.
risk: The lighter strokes may lose contrast when very small.

name: Heavy
description: Thick strokes match the pictorial mark’s outlines.
risk: Small counters close sooner at 175 pixels.

name: Spaced
description: More space between letters makes the name easier to scan at large sizes.
risk: The extra width makes letters smaller in the sidebar.

name: Narrow square
description: Narrow square letters with a tall visual rhythm.

name: Stencil
description: Two narrow stencil cuts through the lettering.
risk: Cuts can disappear at small sizes; better for print or large use.

name: Two lines
description: FAT sits above MATRYOSHKA at the same letter height.
risk: The short first line changes the balance with the icon.

name: Forward
description: A slight forward slant with straight, equal-height letters.
risk: Leans away from the calm shape of the dolls.

name: Rounded lines
description: Custom single-width strokes, drawn like patch cables.
risk: The line-built letters are less dense and need more width.
